method: Every final PDF page rendered with PyMuPDF at scale 1.65 and visually inspected. This records visual review, not an additional simulation or independent scientific peer review.

pages.observations: Abstract, evidence limits and score equation are legible; native counters and 6 fs margin retained.
System return path, compressed-position scope and numerical equations are legible.
FP4 datapath, group/head reduction, AXI boundary and reuse contract are legible.
Packed records, command flow, beat formulas and opaque-KV qualification are legible.
Core, native-run and mode tables fit columns; host time and busy cycles are distinguished.
Actual completion waveform and measured memory-period/traffic plots are readable with units and captions.
Lane-cycle plot, synthesis table, physical limits and all eight references fit the final page.

rendered_images_scope: Local ignored paper/build outputs; regenerate from the PDF for inspection.
post_formatting_check: After removing source-only trailing whitespace, all seven rendered PNG SHA256 digests are identical to the individually inspected pages.
